forbidden.name: db-test-only-from-tests-only
forbidden.comment: Test helpers that bypass transactionSealed are reached only from test files.

forbidden.name: store-only-from-service
forbidden.comment: Mutable state is reached only through service.

forbidden.name: service-only-from-trpc
forbidden.comment: Business logic is reached only through the trpc API.

forbidden.name: web-no-zod
forbidden.comment: web validates through @wizard/domain schemas and never imports zod.

forbidden.name: clerk-only-in-web-and-trpc
forbidden.comment: Clerk stays at the edges; service and domain see only the domain Viewer.

forbidden.name: db-libs-only-in-store
forbidden.comment: Drizzle, postgres and Supabase are reached only through store.

forbidden.name: service-no-ancestor-imports
forbidden.comment: Files in service never import from a parent directory.

forbidden.name: no-junk-drawer-folders
forbidden.comment: Cross-context code lives only in shared/; anything else shared is a missing bounded context.

forbidden.name: contexts-are-flat
forbidden.comment: A context that needs subfolders is two contexts.

forbidden.name: service-context-public-api-only
forbidden.comment: Contexts reach each other only through the other context's index.ts.

forbidden.name: service-root-reexports-context-index-only
forbidden.comment: service/src/index.ts re-exports each context's index.ts, nothing else.

forbidden.name: web-no-ancestor-imports
forbidden.comment: A component may import its children in subfolders, never the reverse.

forbidden.name: generic-components-are-leaves
forbidden.comment: Generic components are prop-only: nothing else from web/src and no @wizard packages.

forbidden.name: api-only-from-domain-view-queries
forbidden.comment: A domain view's queries.ts is its only door to trpc; main.tsx wires the queryClient.

forbidden.name: domain-views-via-index
forbidden.comment: Domain views reach each other only through the other domain view's index.ts.

forbidden.name: routes-use-domain-views-via-index
forbidden.comment: Routes reach domain views only through the domain view's index.ts.

forbidden.name: nothing-imports-routes
forbidden.comment: Only the generated route tree wires routes; route-private folders stay private to routes.

forbidden.name: route-code-has-one-parent
forbidden.comment: Code in a - folder has exactly one importer. A second importer means it's shared: move it to genericComponents or domainViews, or up into the shared parent.

forbidden.name: root-route-code-imported-at-most-three-times
forbidden.comment: routes/-root code with more than 3 importers has outgrown the root route; promote it to domainViews or genericComponents.

forbidden.name: display-components-no-data
forbidden.comment: Only containers (route files and *Section.tsx) read data; display components get it as props.

forbidden.name: domain-view-index-only-from-containers
forbidden.comment: A domain view's index.ts re-exports its data hooks, so only containers may import it.

forbidden.name: contexts-global-only-from-containers
forbidden.comment: App-wide contexts are data; only containers (route files and *Section.tsx) mount or read them.

forbidden.name: not-to-unresolvable
forbidden.comment: An unresolved import would slip past every path rule above.
